messages:
carla: PTAL — addressed the feedback from yesterday and pushed a follow-up. Moved the flaky unit into integration/tests/flaky, added a smoke script under infra/smoke/run_smoke.sh, and included a short changelog entry.
carla: main changes are: small rename (RequestPool -> ReqPool), fixed off-by-one in allocator, and added a feature-flag guard for the new batching path.
alex: scanning now, thanks. quick q — did you keep the old metric name for compatibility?
carla: yep, kept metric.old_request_latency and added metric.reqpool_latency for the new path. preserved tags.
lee: small nit: in the smoke script can you avoid sudo? CI can't run it that way in GKE jobs.
carla: good catch. switched to non-root invocation, updated README snippet. pushing.
sam: lgtm on the changes; one micro-suggestion about the var name in allocator (reqs -> requests) but not blocking.
alex: i left an inline about a tiny test timeout; bumping from 200ms -> 500ms seems reasonable in noisy env.
carla: applied both (renamed var, bumped timeout). squashed the fixups into the last commit.
lee: can we queue this for canary tomorrow morning? if CI green i'll +1.
carla: scheduled canary slot for 09:00 UTC tomorrow and added smoke instructions in the PR description.
ci-bot: CI status: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). deployment window reserved at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z.
alex: thanks — PTAL again if you have a minute, otherwise i'll merge after canary completes.
carla: thanks all. ping me if the canary shows any anomaly, i'll be on-call during the slot. :thumbsup:
